description.html: The Resun PO-019 is a polyresin decoration shaped like a tilted ancient amphora lying on a moss-covered rock. The amphora is in turquoise and gray tones, with a decorative pattern on the body and an opening on the side, so it looks like an object from a sunken ship that has become overgrown over time. At 10.5 x 7.5 x 11 cm, it suits small and medium aquariums.

The inside of the amphora is a favorite hiding place for small fish and shrimp, which feel safe in an enclosed space. Calm fish that spend part of the day in cover quickly adopt it as their spot. With stones, sand and plants, the amphora brings in an ancient ruins motif, and it also pairs well with the Resun PO-013 stone bridge.

Before placing it, rinse the amphora in lukewarm water, without detergents. Set it firmly on the bottom with the opening facing sideways or toward the front glass, and make sure sand does not bury the entrance. Rinse out debris that collects inside from time to time during water changes, and remove algae from the surface with a soft brush.
